sectionsUsed: Media Queries: create a simple single-column layout for narrow screens, then check for wider screens and add a multiple-column layout; this is mobile first design. Page claims: teach step 2, breakpoint builder, apply question, GIFT o1 items.

The viewport meta tag: mobile browsers set the viewport width to 980 pixels, render the page at that width and show a zoomed-out version; width=device-width overrides that default; initial-scale=1. Page claims: teach step 3, drawn phone simulation, GIFT o2.
Responsive images/media: img, picture, video { max-width: 100%; } so media never overflows its container. Page claims: teach step 4, overflow fixer, GIFT o3.
3 Viewport meta element: the recognized properties width (including device-width) and initial-scale. Page claims: the viewport meta element content width=device-width, initial-scale=1.

4.1 Width: the width media feature and its min-width and max-width range forms; min-width matches when the viewport width is at least the value. Page claims: min-width matches at its width and wider, max-width matches narrower, GIFT o1 what min-width means.
